name: featherreader-oauth-sidecar
description: atproto OAuth confidential-client sidecar for FeatherReader — owns the OAuth handshake (PAR/PKCE/DPoP/token-refresh) so the Rust server never touches it. Exposes login/callback + an internal shared-secret-guarded authed com.atproto.repo.* API.

scripts.test:guard: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');let f=[];try{f=fs.readdirSync('dist-test/test',{recursive:true}).filter(n=>String(n).endsWith('.test.js'))}catch(e){};if(f.length<5){console.error('FAIL: found '+f.length+' compiled test files under dist-test/test, expected at least 5. node --test exits 0 when it matches nothing, so this guard is what turns a vanished suite into a red build.');process.exit(1)}console.log('[guard] '+f.length+' compiled test files')"
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run test:guard && node --test 'dist-test/test/**/*.test.js'
